import subprocess, time, filecmp, sys
t0 = time.perf_counter()
for _ in range(3):
    r = subprocess.run(["python3", "sortints.py"], stdin=open("input.txt", "rb"), stdout=open("out.txt", "wb"), stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print(0); sys.exit(0)
t1 = time.perf_counter()
if not filecmp.cmp("out.txt", "expected.txt", shallow=False):
    print(0); sys.exit(0)
print(f"{3.0 / (t1 - t0):.4f}")
